board: Joy-IT SensorKit KY-039 heartbeat sensor (SEN-KY039HS, round board on a 3-wire lead: - grey, + white, S black)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. S is modelled as a pulse waveform (peak size and BPM controls, positive peak per beat like Joy-IT's scope trace), and the driver's peak-tracking beat counter prints BPM=75 at 75 BPM with 0.5 V peaks.
breakoutPinoutSource: https://sensorkit.joy-it.net/en/sensors/ky-039 (039-Pico.svg drawing shows board marks -, +, S; pin table: black = Signal, white = +V, grey = GND; circuit KY-039-Phototransistor.svg)
